method: Read official installers and archive launchers without executing an installer, CLI, model, or downloaded binary.

linux_x64.argv0: The launcher uses exec -a with the invoked agent or cursor-agent alias.

windows_x64.archive_inspection: HEAD returned 403; HTTP Range GET succeeded. Read only the central directory and launcher/package metadata members.

github_search.results: Both official organization repository searches returned zero results. Classification evidence comes from official release artifacts.

classification: Recognize index.js only as the immediate file inside cursor-agent/versions/<nonempty release>/, after parsing a known runtime's real entrypoint. Shared runtime switches must include --use-system-ca. An agent or cursor-agent basename alone does not establish identity.
limitations: Process metadata is inferred from inspected startup code; no real Cursor process was launched or sampled.
macOS, arm64, relocated installations, and future launcher changes were not inspected.
Helper scripts and bundled binaries other than the verified index.js entrypoint do not gain additional signatures.
